book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: وصلت بغداد بعد سبع وعشرين سنة من أول رحلة.
sentences.en: I reached Baghdad twenty-seven years after the first voyage.

sentences.ar: ودخلت على الخليفة، وحكيت له عن الفيلة.
sentences.en: And I went in to the Caliph, and told him about the elephants.
And he said: Sindbad, enough.
I send you nowhere from this day.

sentences.ar: وأمر يكتبوا رحلاتي السبع بماء الذهب، وتنحفظ بخزانته.
sentences.en: And he ordered my seven voyages written in gold ink, and kept in his treasury.

sentences.ar: عشان اللي بعدنا يعرفوا شو في بالبحر.
sentences.en: So that those after us know what is in the sea.
And I came home to my house, this house.
And I bought the garden, the servants, the singers.

sentences.ar: وكل يوم بقعد هون، وبسمع الموسيقى، وبآكل.
sentences.en: And every day I sit here, listen to the music, and eat.
And every night I dream of the sea.
But I do not go back to it.
Because I have grown old, and because I have learned.
And the porter asked: learned what?
Sindbad said: I learned something.

sentences.ar: اللي بيطلع بالسفينة، بيرجع إشي تاني.
sentences.en: Whoever goes out on a ship comes back as something else.

sentences.ar: وإن اللوح بيجي، بس لازم تمسكه.
sentences.en: And that the plank comes, but you must grab it.

sentences.ar: وإن الجوع بيغير الإنسان، والخوف كمان، والذهب أكتر.
sentences.en: And that hunger changes a person, and fear too, and gold most of all.

sentences.ar: وإن الغريب بيحب كل بلد، وبيشتاق لبلد واحدة.
sentences.en: And that the stranger loves every country, and longs for one.

sentences.ar: وإن اللي بياخد أكتر من حاجته، البحر بياخد منه.
sentences.en: And that whoever takes more than he needs, the sea takes from him.

sentences.ar: هاد اللي تعلمته، بسبع وعشرين سنة.
sentences.en: That is what I learned, in twenty-seven years.
And seven voyages, and seven deaths.
And then he looked at the porter.

sentences.ar: وقال: وإنت، يا سندباد الحمّال، شو تعلمت؟
sentences.en: And he said: and you, Sindbad the porter, what have you learned?

sentences.ar: قال الحمّال: تعلمت إني ما بدي أكون إنت.
sentences.en: The porter said: I learned that I do not want to be you.
But I want to be your friend.
And Sindbad the sailor laughed, and rose, and embraced him.

sentences.ar: وقال: من اليوم، إنت بتاكل على سفرتي، وما بتحمل حمل لحدا.
sentences.en: And he said: from today, you eat at my table, and carry no load for anyone.
And he gave him a hundred dinars, for the last time.
And the two lived in Baghdad, friends.

sentences.ar: لحد ما إجا اللي ما بيرحم حدا.
sentences.en: Until there came what spares no one.
And that is the end of the tale of Sindbad.
